#elif $input_type_selector == 'molecules': ## python "${__tool_directory__}/process_molecules.py" --path $input_molecules --stem $stem --has_header $has_header --gene_col_name $gene_col_name --x_col_name $x_col_name --y_col_name $y_col_name --delimiter $delimiter --x_scale $x_scale --y_scale $y_scale --x_offset $x_offset --y_offset $y_offset --gene_col_idx $gene_col_idx --x_col_idx $x_col_idx --y_col_idx $y_col_idx --filter_col_name $filter_col_name --filter_col_idx $filter_col_idx --filter_col_value $filter_col_value && ## param.name: input_type_selector
param.label: Choose the type of input data

param.name: compute_embeddings
param.label: Compute embeddings
param.help: If `X_umap` and `X_pca` embeddings will be computed.

param.name: var_index
param.label: Alternative var index
param.help: Alternative `var` column name with `var` names to be used in the visualization.

param.name: obs_subset
param.label: Subset obs
param.help: Subset the AnnData object on a specific 'obs' column with one or more values.

param.name: obs_subset_column
param.label: obs column name
param.help: obs column to apply the subset on.

param.name: var_subset
param.label: Subset var
param.help: Subset the AnnData object on a specific 'var' column with one or more values.

param.name: var_subset_column
param.label: var column name
param.help: var column to apply the subset on.

param.name: batch_processing
param.label: Enable batch processing
param.help: If the expression matrix will be written to Zarr incrementally. Use to avoid loading the whole AnnData into memory.

param.name: batch_size
param.label: Batch size
param.help: The amount of rows (if matrix is in CSR format) or columns (if matrix is dense or in CSC format) of the expression matrix to process at a time when batch processing.

param.name: load_clusters
param.label: Include cluster files
param.help: If cluster files should be included in the AnnData object.

param.name: load_embeddings
param.label: Include embeddings
param.help: If embedding coordinates files should be included in the AnnData object.

param.name: load_raw
param.label: Use raw matrix count file
param.help: If the raw matrix count file should be loaded instead of the filtered matrix.

param.name: save_h5ad
param.label: Save h5ad file
param.help: If the AnnData object should also be written to an h5ad file.

param.name: spatial_as_pixel
param.label: Convert spatial coordinates to pixels
param.help: Boolean indicating whether spatial coordinates should be converted to pixels.

param.name: save_h5ad
param.label: Save h5ad file
param.help: If the AnnData object should also be written to an h5ad file.

param.name: filter_prefix
param.label: Filter prefix
param.help: Prefix to filter out of the data.

param.name: save_h5ad
param.label: Save h5ad file
param.help: If the AnnData object should also be written to an h5ad file.

data.name: output_h5ad
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: h5ad output
data.filter: 'h5ad' not in input_type['input_type_selector'] and 'molecules' not in input_type['input_type_selector'] and input_type['save_h5ad']

data.name: output_zarr
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: compressed zarr output
data.filter: input_type['input_type_selector'] == 'h5ad' or input_type['input_type_selector'] == 'spaceranger' or input_type['input_type_selector'] == 'xenium' or input_type['input_type_selector'] == 'merscope'
